title: HORIA: 4D Human and Object Reconstruction from a Monocular Video with Interaction-Aware Re-Rendering
title_zh: HORIA：基于交互感知重渲染的单目视频4D人与物体重建

paragraphs.en: HORIA提出交互感知重渲染方法，从单目视频实现人与物体的联合4D重建，在遮挡和交互变化场景下达到最先进效果。 Joint 4D reconstruction of a human and object from a monocular video is essential for understanding how people interact with their environment. While recent methods have made noticeable progress, capturing such human-object interactions remains difficult due to two main challenges. First, a video typically contains composite semantic context spanning multiple interaction phases, making it difficult to track the temporal changes of the interaction in the reconstruction. Second, under human-object occlusion, a single-view observation contains incomplete visual information about the interaction, resulting in geometrically inconsistent reconstructions. To address these challenges, we introduce HORIA, built upon two core designs. First, we decompose the entire input video into temporally grounded and semantically distinct interaction phases with motion-aware captioning, obtaining a specific text description for each phase. Second, conditioned on these text descriptions of the interaction, we propose an interaction-aware re-rendering that compensates for the limited single-view observation. Specifically, we render the initially reconstructed 4D human and object from novel viewpoints and refine the renderings with a text-to-video diffusion prior, which provides auxiliary novel-view supervision beyond single-view cues. As a result, our framework produces temporally coherent and accurate 4D reconstructions under diverse interaction scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
paragraphs.zh: HORIA提出交互感知重渲染方法，从单目视频实现人与物体的联合4D重建，在遮挡和交互变化场景下达到最先进效果。从单目视频中对人和物体进行联合4D重建，对于理解人如何与环境交互至关重要。 尽管最近的方法已经取得了显著进展，但由于两大挑战，捕捉此类人-物体交互仍然十分困难。 首先，一段视频通常包含跨越多个交互阶段的复合语义上下文，这使得在重建中难以追踪交互的时序变化。 其次，在人-物体遮挡情况下，单视角观测包含的关于交互的视觉信息不完整，导致几何上不一致的重建结果。 为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了HORIA，它建立在两个核心设计之上。 首先，我们利用运动感知描述将整个输入视频分解为时序上有据可依且语义上各不相同的交互阶段，并为每个阶段获得具体的文本描述。 其次，以这些关于交互的文本描述为条件，我们提出了一种交互感知重渲染方法，以弥补单视角观测的不足。 具体而言，我们从新视角渲染初始重建的4D人体和物体，并用文本到视频扩散先验对渲染结果进行精化，从而在单视角线索之外提供辅助的新视角监督。 由此，我们的框架在多样化交互场景下产生时序连贯且准确的4D重建，达到了最先进的性能。
